name: PT Jobubu Jarum Minahasa TBK
summary: PT Jobubu Jarum Minahasa TBK is an Indonesian company primarily engaged in the production and distribution of alcoholic beverages. Its current product lineup includes well-known brands like Cap Tikus 1978, Daebak Soju, and Daebak Spark. The company's operations extend across various segments of the beverage industry, specifically distilled spirits, fermented wines, and malt-based alcoholic drinks, along with other agricultural products. Founded in 2018 and headquartered in Minahasa, Indonesia, it operates as a subsidiary of PT Maju Beverage Minahasa.
